title: Jason and the Argonauts
description: The Greek hero (Todd Armstrong) sails through Harpies and clashing rocks to the Golden Fleece, guarded by the Hydra.

title: You Were Never Lovelier
description: A tycoon (Adolphe Menjou) sends anonymous gifts to his daughter (Rita Hayworth) to make her fall for a mystery man he will choose later, but a dancer (Fred Astaire) he doesn't like takes the credit.

title: Walk, Don't Run
description: A British businessman (Cary Grant) shares an apartment with a U.S. athlete (Jim Hutton) and a diplomat's fiancée (Samantha Eggar) during the Tokyo Olympics.

title: From Here to Eternity
description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.

title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
description: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.

title: The Whole Town's Talking
description: A bookkeeper (Edward G. Robinson) learns he looks just like a gangster whom police plan to shoot on sight.

title: The Awful Truth
description: Spouses (Irene Dunne, Cary Grant) try to spoil each other's chances for romance before their divorce becomes final in 90 days.

title: Gidget
description: A California girl called Gidget (Sandra Dee) spends summer with surf bums called Moondoggie (James Darren) and Kahuna (Cliff Robertson).

title: Forbidden
description: The mistress (Barbara Stanwyck) of a lawyer (Adolphe Menjou) running for governor marries an editor (Ralph Bellamy), who finds she has a baby.

title: Mickey One
description: A nightclub comic (Warren Beatty) in debt to mobsters hides in Chicago at the mercy of his ego.

title: Cactus Flower
description: A dentist (Walter Matthau) has his prim assistant (Ingrid Bergman) pose as his wife to discourage his kooky girlfriend (Goldie Hawn).

title: Holiday
description: A tomboy New York socialite (Katharine Hepburn) flirts with her stuffy sister's (Doris Nolan) down-to-earth fiancé (Cary Grant).

title: You Can't Run Away From It
description: A newsman (Jack Lemmon) rides a bus, hitchhikes and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Charles Bickford) runaway daughter (June Allyson).

title: Anatomy of a Murder
description: A Michigan lawyer (James Stewart) and his colleague defend an Army lieutenant (Ben Gazzara) who killed the man who raped the officer's wife (Lee Remick).
